shared_elements: boat/ship with upturned prow and stern
repeated vertical strokes in a row
justification: Both surfaces show small schematic human figures and rows of repeated marks, and A contains boat-like signs among its script while B is dominated by a large boat with upturned ends and a quadruped above it, but this overlap is generic. A is a formal stele with an offering scene of figures raising arms before a radiant disc above many registers of dense script, whereas B is a free-field composition of a single large ship with a crew row and isolated figures, with no textual registers, no disc, and no offering relationship.
